serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Sixtyfour provides AI-powered identity intelligence for government investigations, vetting and fraud detection. Its research platform and APIs investigate people and organizations across public records and online sources, resolving identities, examining backgrounds and uncovering relationships. Sixtyfour turns fragmented information into source-backed intelligence for individual cases, large-scale analysis and ongoing monitoring.

trustCenter.repositoryDescription: Trust Center containing all the necessary documentation for FedRAMP Certification submission package.
trustCenter.accessRequestInstructions: Access requests can be submitted by pressing the 'Request Access' button on the top right of the Trust Center.
